scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const h=fs.readFileSync('client/index.html','utf8');if(!h.includes('</html>'))throw new Error('client/index.html is truncated');if(!h.includes('app.js'))throw new Error('client/index.html does not load app.js');if(!fs.existsSync('client/src/ui/ai.worker.js')||!fs.existsSync('client/src/ai/ai.worker.ts')||!fs.readFileSync('client/src/ai/aiClient.ts','utf8').includes('/src/ai/ai.worker.bundle.js'))throw new Error('client worker entry mismatch');if(!fs.existsSync('server/entry.js'))throw new Error('server entrypoint missing');if(!fs.existsSync('client/app.js')||!fs.existsSync('client/styles.css')||!fs.existsSync('server/main.js')||!fs.existsSync('server/roomServer.js'))throw new Error('frontend or backend files missing');for(const p of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','src'])if(fs.existsSync(p))throw new Error('frontend file remains at root: '+p);console.log('check ok')"
scripts.test: node --test test/smoke.test.js test/roomServer.test.js && vitest run --exclude test/smoke.test.js --exclude test/roomServer.test.js
